meta.homeDescription: A fun Vietnamese learning journey for children of the Vietnamese diaspora aged 5 to 12, under the patronage of the State Committee for Overseas Vietnamese, Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
meta.homeOgDescription: Learn Vietnamese with Trâu con, the little buffalo in a conical hat: 8 topics and 40 lessons for children of the Vietnamese diaspora.

mission.title: Helping every overseas Vietnamese child <accent>keep their Vietnamese</accent>, for free
mission.lede: Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em brings the Vui học Tiếng Việt book series online as a four-step journey: the alphabet, book 1, book 2 and speaking practice. Free, for life, for every child.

alphabet.title: Alphabet
alphabet.body: Get to know the Vietnamese alphabet through pictures, sounds and games.

book1.title: Book 1
book1.body: The first four topics: family, school and the friends around you.

book2.title: Book 2
book2.body: The next four topics: homeland, nature and Vietnamese culture.

speaking.title: Speaking practice
speaking.body: Listen, repeat and record yourself to speak Vietnamese more clearly and confidently every day.

press.title: In the press
press.lede: Vietnamese media on the learning platform, classes, library and activities of the Canada–Vietnam Cultural and Educational Council.
press.videoFailed: The video can’t play here. You can watch the original on the Vietnam News Agency website.

partner.heading: Expert support
partner.body: The project is carried out with the support and endorsement of the <hl>State Committee for Overseas Vietnamese, Ministry of Foreign Affairs</hl>.

digitization.heading: A digitization project
digitization.body: Bringing online two books from Ho Chi Minh City University of Education Publishing House, as part of the Honoring the Vietnamese Language in Overseas Vietnamese Communities program launched by the State Committee for Overseas Vietnamese, Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

ecosystem.heading: Ecosystem
ecosystem.body: The project is an active member of the Network of Vietnamese Language and Culture Teaching Institutions Abroad.

copyright.heading: Copyright
copyright.body: Copyright held by the co-authors: Phan Thị Quỳnh Trang, Nguyễn Trần Thanh Hải, Đỗ Thị Phương Mai, Trần Thanh Phúc, Trần Văn Nhật.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: The project team sincerely thanks the <hl>State Committee for Overseas Vietnamese, Ministry of Foreign Affairs</hl> of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam for its constant support and guidance. We are deeply grateful to the embassies, government agencies in Vietnam and Canada, and the Vietnamese teaching network for their generous help in completing and launching <hl>"Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em"</hl>. Your support is a great source of motivation as we preserve and share the Vietnamese language and culture with young people in Canada and around the world.

support.title: Support us
support.heading: Help every child keep their Vietnamese.
support.body: <hl>"Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em"</hl> is a non-profit project. We always welcome support, contributions and sponsorship from parents, the Vietnamese diaspora and benefactors. Every contribution, however small, is precious.

free.heading: Keep the whole program free
free.body: 40+ lessons across 8 topics, open to every child, for life, at no cost.

content.heading: Bring more content online
content.body: Continuing the Vui học Tiếng Việt book series from Ho Chi Minh City University of Education Publishing House.

speaking.heading: Grow speaking practice
speaking.body: Pictures, sounds, games and recording to help children speak Vietnamese with more confidence.

closing.title: Learn Vietnamese anytime, anywhere
closing.lede: Trâu con is ready in his conical hat. Open the first lesson and start your journey.
